text: The ultrasound and CA-125 results show normal readings, which is reassuring but does not fully explain the postmenopausal bleeding. speaker: Doctor
text: The endometrial biopsy confirms well-differentiated adenocarcinoma, which explains the postmenopausal bleeding. The adnexal mass may represent metastatic disease or a synchronous primary tumor, but the endometrial cancer is the primary diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma
